confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: These are supported competition categories, not a record that SPACE Y selected one or received a facility-bay assignment.

confirmed_external_constraints.item: maximum chamber pressure for engine design
confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: Hard upper limit for engine design; it is not a recommended target or evidence that transient pressure is acceptable.
The guide says recommended below 70 bar(g), while the applicable ICD equipment limit must also be met. This is not converted into a team operating setpoint.

confirmed_external_constraints.item: PDR Part A language and length
confirmed_external_constraints.source_locator: PDF page 4, section 03 PDR 문서 구성
confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: Part A is the scored main body; Part B is an unscored optional appendix.
The guide requires these fields to be stated; it does not provide SPACE Y values for them. Supply pressure is at the injector inlet.
The exact closing time and presentation-material schedule are to be confirmed by later notice.

confirmed_external_constraints.source_locator: guide PDF page 3; AEL ICD PDF page 1
confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: Facility envelope only; not a target thrust and not confirmation of test allocation.
AEL notes that higher delivery pressure reduces achievable maximum mass flow; this range is not a verified simultaneous pressure-flow envelope.
Individual nominal limits/capacities; usable mass, simultaneous pressure-flow capability and assigned bay remain unconfirmed.
Individual nominal limits/capacities; exact composition, usable mass and simultaneous pressure-flow capability remain unconfirmed.

confirmed_external_constraints.value: M10 threaded holes on 135 x 50 mm pitch; team provides mount; thrust axis aligned with plate centreline
confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: AEL recommends 12 mm holes in the team bracket; final mount design and rear-clearance verification remain team work.

confirmed_external_constraints.item: AEL IPA and N2O fluid-port guidance
confirmed_external_constraints.value: IPA delivery 1/2 inch tube and suggested 1/4-1/2 inch BSPP female engine port; N2O delivery 3/4 inch tube and suggested 1/2 or 3/4 inch BSPP female engine port
confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: Port selection must still be checked against required flow and sealing; the suggested sizes are not an injector design.

confirmed_external_constraints.value: 10 kHz, 16-bit acquisition; delivered propellant pressure/temperature/mass flow and thrust; up to 8 pressure transducers and 16 thermocouples
confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: AEL recommends at least one chamber-pressure tapping; sensor selection, range, location and abort criteria remain team decisions.

confirmed_external_constraints.value: AEL ASI required by guide; facility or team igniter permitted; facility torch igniter uses 1/4 inch BSPP interface
confirmed_external_constraints.source_locator: guide PDF page 4; AEL ICD PDF page 7, section 5 Ignition
confirmed_external_constraints.interpretation: Ignition method and interface implementation are not yet selected by SPACE Y.

historical_provisional_cases.interpretation: A personal review case with CEA output, not an approved team requirement, optimum, actual facility state, or safe design.

immediate.item: select propellant pair and intended AEL bay/assignment basis
immediate.reason: Required to establish facility envelope and exact fluid definitions; the competition options do not select a SPACE Y configuration.

immediate.item: approve target thrust, ambient/back-pressure condition, and tolerance
immediate.reason: Blocks sizing basis, performance comparison and RPA preliminary geometry.

immediate.item: approve chamber-pressure and mixture-ratio candidate set
immediate.reason: Blocks CEA/RPA candidate comparison; historical 25 bar(a) and O/F 2.50 are not team-approved.

immediate.item: approve burn duration and duty-cycle definition
immediate.reason: Required for propellant inventory, cooling duration, supply and test planning.

immediate.item: define 2-3 actual candidate IDs and approve one comparison input sheet
immediate.reason: The Decision Engine cannot compare actual candidates without an approved candidate set.

immediate.item: select RPA sizing control, chamber count, nozzle design condition and nozzle shape
immediate.reason: Required for a reproducible conditional preliminary geometry run.

provisional_possible.item: chamber characteristic length or chamber length basis
provisional_possible.reason: May be adopted provisionally only with a literature/source range, sensitivity case and change trigger.
May support preliminary RPA geometry if explicitly labeled provisional and traced to a source.

provisional_possible.item: facility typical inlet temperatures as preliminary run cases
provisional_possible.reason: AEL publishes typical N2O 10 degC and IPA 20 degC, but these are not guaranteed actual inlet states or team-approved values.

followup_required.item: facility pressure-flow envelope, usable inventory and transient supply evidence
followup_required.reason: Needed before supply feasibility or test readiness can be claimed.

followup_required.item: validated exact-IPA property backend and coolant inlet state
followup_required.reason: Needed before M0 output can be used as actual cooling evidence.

followup_required.item: cooling-channel, wall/material, injector, joint/seal and mounting detail
followup_required.reason: RPA geometry does not complete regenerative, structural, combustion-stability or facility-interface design.

followup_required.item: approved acceptance limits, margins, instrumentation and abort criteria
followup_required.reason: Required before manufacturing/test release; no safety limit is invented by the software.
